current_decision.data: Preserve exact current corpus for this complete-epoch continuation; no mid-run shard/label changes.
current_decision.recipe: Two further full epochs, nominalLR5e-6 with inherited0.5 updater, effective batch4; all original retention/objectives and Adam history preserved.
current_decision.reason: First compare actual free-running failures after the diagnosed speech-output fix, then measure learning beyond one large-adapter epoch. This is not a claim of a unique causal diagnosis.

next_review.trigger: Full native64 result plus epoch DEV/TRAIN trends and post-training speech/behavior.
next_review.data_hypothesis: If spurious delegation/low ordinary correctness persist despite falling training loss, add more ordinary non-delegation contrasts and broader real conversation/technical explanations, with complex tasks delegated. Keep held-out task structures and synthetic worlds separate.
next_review.recipe_hypothesis: If TRAIN and DEV jointly improve with stable ordinary retention, more useful training may be justified; if DEV/behavior degrades as TRAIN improves, review mixture/regularization rather than blindly add epochs or parameters.
next_review.rendering_hypothesis: Correct generated user-facing words with missing or wrong audio calls for acoustic/runtime repair, not language labels rewritten to match a broken renderer.
next_review.fresh_evaluation: Prepare a separate uninspected product cohort before claiming generalization or adoption.
